result.topic_en: A proof (replacing an earlier inductive lemma) expressing a quantity M as a combination of floor-function sums φ(a,b), reducing it to twice a sum of floors [(2k+1)a/2b] plus correction terms, for a odd and b even, in the context of biquadratic residues.
result.transcription:
Das obige nur auf Induction gegründete Lemma wird durch folgendes er[?]
Man hat für $a, b-a$ positiv
$M = -P + Q - R$, wo
$P = [\frac{b}{a}] + [\frac{2b}{a}] + [\frac{3b}{a}] \ldots + [\frac{\frac{1}{2}(a-1)b}{a}] = \varphi(a,b) = \frac{1}{4}(a-1)b - \varphi(b,a)$
$Q = [\frac{1}{2}b + \frac{a}{2b}], [\frac{1}{2}b + \frac{3a}{2b}], [\frac{1}{2}b + \frac{5a}{2b}] \ldots + [\frac{1}{2}b + \frac{(b-1)a}{2b}]$
$= \frac{1}{4}bb + \varphi(2b,a) - \varphi(b,a)$
$R = [\frac{b+a}{b-a}] + [\frac{2(b+a)}{b-a}] + [\frac{3(b+a)}{b-a}] + etc. + [\frac{\frac{1}{2}(b-a-1)(b+a)}{b-a}]$
$= \varphi(b-a, b+a)$
Also
$M = \frac{1}{4}bb - \frac{1}{4}(a-1)b + \varphi(2b,a) - \varphi(b-a,b+a)$
Nun ist
$\varphi(b-a,b+a) = \varphi(b-a,2b) - \frac{1}{8}(b-a)^2 + \frac{1}{8}$
$= \frac{1}{2}(b-a-1)b - \frac{1}{8}(b-a)^2 + \frac{1}{8} - \varphi(2b, b-a)$
$= \frac{3}{8}bb - \frac{1}{4}ab - \frac{1}{8}aa - \frac{1}{2}b + \frac{1}{8} - \varphi(2b, b-a)$
Also
$M = \frac{1}{8}aa - \frac{1}{8}bb + \frac{3}{4}b - \frac{1}{8} + \varphi(2b,a) + \varphi(2b,b-a)$
Da nun a ungerade und b gerade ist, so wird
$\varphi(2b,b-a) = [\frac{b-a}{2b}] + [\frac{3(b-a)}{2b}] + [\frac{5(b-a)}{2b}] + [\frac{7(b-a)}{2b}] \ldots + [\frac{(b-1)(b-a)}{2b}]$
$+ [\frac{b-a}{b}] + [\frac{2(b-a)}{b}] + [\frac{3(b-a)}{b}] \ldots + [\frac{\frac{1}{2}b(b-a)}{b}]$
oder wenn die ersten Theile rückwerts genommen werden
$= \Big\{ [\frac{a}{2b}] + [\frac{3a}{2b}] + [\frac{5a}{2b}] \ldots + [\frac{(b-1)a}{2b}] + \frac{b-a-1}{2} + \frac{b-a-3}{2} + \frac{b-a-5}{2} \ldots - \frac{a-1}{2}$
$- [\frac{a}{b}] - [\frac{2a}{b}] - [\frac{3a}{b}] \ldots - [\frac{\frac{1}{2}ba}{b}] + 1 + 2 + 3 + \ldots \frac{1}{2}b - 1$
Also
$\varphi(2b,a) + \varphi(2b,b-a) =$ [-$[\frac{a}{2b}] + [\frac{3a}{2b}]$-]
$2\{[\frac{a}{2b}] + [\frac{3a}{2b}] + [\frac{5a}{2b}] \ldots + [\frac{(b-1)a}{2b}]\} + \frac{b(b-a-1)}{4}$
und
$M = 2\{[\frac{a}{2b}] + [\frac{3a}{2b}] + [\frac{5a}{2b}] \ldots + [\frac{(b-1)a}{2b}]\} + \frac{1}{8}(D-1) + \frac{1}{2}b - \frac{1}{4}ab$
